architecture_type: Multi-Tenant SaaS Telecom Operating System & Customer Management Platform
executive_summary: Comprehensive 3-Tier Multi-Tenant Architecture & 2-Dimensional Organizational Hierarchy (Branches x Departments) enforcing strict PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) and granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

tier_1_platform_owner.name: SaaS Platform Owner (Super-Admin)
tier_1_platform_owner.scope: Global SaaS Infrastructure across all ISP Tenant Organizations

routes./platform: Global Overview & SaaS Health HUD (Active Tenants, MRR, 48k+ Global Subscribers)
routes./platform/companies: Tenant ISP Provisioning & RLS Schema Allocation
routes./platform/subscriptions: SaaS Tier Plans (Starter, Growth, Enterprise) & Limit Configuration
routes./platform/system: Global API Gateway Latency (0.3ms), Redis Pub/Sub, DB Connection Pools
routes./platform/audit: Platform-Wide Immutable Security & Cross-Tenant Audit Logs

tier_2_company_portal.name: Unified Company CMS Portal
tier_2_company_portal.scope: Tenant Organization Level with Automatic RBAC Dynamic Filtering
tier_2_company_portal.architecture_pattern: ONE Single Next.js Layout Shell with Dynamic Sidebar & Route Guards

routes./app/desk: Prime Desk 3-Column Live Chat Workspace (Inbox, Stream, Customer 360 Telemetry)
routes./app/staff: Staff Directory, Provisioning, Department & Branch Assignment
routes./app/roles: Custom RBAC Permission Matrix Builder (Module x Action Matrix)
routes./app/branches: 20 Regional Distribution Hubs, Subnets & Van Fleet Tracking
routes./app/supervisor: Supervisor Live Operations HUD & Real-Time Agent Occupancy / SLA Radar
routes./app/reports: Operational Analytics, MTTR, First Response Time (FRT), CSAT Distribution
routes./app/settings/working-hours: Weekly Shift Schedules & Automated Out-of-Office Responders

routes./customer/chat: 2-Way Real-Time Chat Stream, Optical Power Status (-19.2 dBm), Payment Slip Upload

routes./login: Universal Staff Login with Tenant Slug Detection & 1-Click Role Demo Fillers

dimension_1_branches.description: Geographic / Regional Distribution Hubs (Physical Location Scope)

roles_and_access_hierarchy.title: SaaS Platform Super-Admin
roles_and_access_hierarchy.description: Creator of the SaaS Platform. Operates at the multi-tenant infrastructure layer.
key_capabilities: Create, suspend, and configure ISP tenant companies
Define global SaaS subscription pricing and limits
Monitor global database latency, Redis cluster, and Cloudflare R2 storage
Perform cross-tenant security audits

roles_and_access_hierarchy.title: Company Owner (ISP CEO / Root)
roles_and_access_hierarchy.description: Executive owner of the specific ISP tenant company (e.g. Prime Networks).
key_capabilities: Manage all 20 regional distribution branches
Add/invite all staff and assign them to branches & departments
Build custom RBAC permission matrices
Full view of all 18,420 subscribers across all branches
Executive analytics, CSAT ratings, and MTTR compliance reports
Switch branch view context with 1-click topbar dropdown

roles_and_access_hierarchy.title: Regional Branch Manager (Branch Head)
roles_and_access_hierarchy.description: Executive manager responsible for a single regional distribution hub (e.g. Islamabad F-10).
key_capabilities: View all customers, tickets, and active chat queues inside assigned branch
Monitor attendance and active occupancy of branch staff
Track branch GPS van fleet (4 vans in F-10) and stock inventory
Access branch-level MTTR and CSAT performance metrics
Cannot view or alter financial/staff data of other branches

roles_and_access_hierarchy.title: Department Manager (e.g. Head of Support / NOC Director)
roles_and_access_hierarchy.description: Functional lead overseeing their specific department across all branches.
key_capabilities: Oversee all helpdesk agents or NOC engineers company-wide
Monitor Supervisor Live HUD with real-time agent occupancy and SLA breach timers
Whisper / silently monitor ongoing chats between staff and subscribers
Configure canned quick-reply templates (/) and working-hour auto-responders

roles_and_access_hierarchy.title: NOC Core / Lead Engineer
roles_and_access_hierarchy.description: Specialist engineer responsible for core network integrity, OLTs, and subnets.
key_capabilities: Inspect real-time SmartOLT optical attenuation dBm gauge on customer 360
Simulate/detect optical fiber breaks (-32.54 dBm) and trigger joint box dispatch
Log private confidential staff audit notes (🔒) invisible to customers
Verify PPPoE live sessions, IP/MAC bindings, and MikroTik core throughput

roles_and_access_hierarchy.title: Helpdesk & Customer Support Officer
roles_and_access_hierarchy.description: 1st-level frontline support answering customer chats in Prime Desk.
key_capabilities: Receive and respond to incoming customer messages in real-time
Insert canned template shortcuts (e.g. /signal, /dispatch, /bill, /reboot)
Transfer chat with mandatory audit reason to specialist engineers
Record mandatory closure outcomes (Resolved, Ticket Created, Unreachable, Spam)
1-Click convert unresolved fiber cuts to field trouble tickets

roles_and_access_hierarchy.title: Field Engineer / Fiber Splicer (Van Fleet)
roles_and_access_hierarchy.description: On-ground field engineer dispatched in mobile vans equipped with OTDR meters.
key_capabilities: Receive real-time push dispatch notifications on mobile/tablet
Navigate to subscriber address via GPS coordinates
Upload OTDR fiber splicing test evidence and resolution photos
Scan hardware ONU QR codes to verify serial replacement (e.g. HWTC-98B2-F104)

roles_and_access_hierarchy.title: Accounts & Billing Officer
roles_and_access_hierarchy.description: Finance officer verifying recharge slips and syncing ZL Ultra billing.
key_capabilities: Review uploaded payment proof screenshots (Nayapay, JazzCash, Bank slips)
Mark receipts verified and post credits directly to ZL Ultra billing ledger
Reactivate suspended PPPoE accounts upon payment confirmation

roles_and_access_hierarchy.title: End-User Subscriber
key_capabilities: Start live web chat conversation with Helpdesk
Upload recharge proof screenshots
View active bandwidth package speed (e.g. 50 Mbps Ultra) and optical status
Rate interaction CSAT (1 to 5 stars)

cross_role_interaction_lifecycle.action: Helpdesk Agent accepts chat & performs remote optical/speed diagnosis
If optical cut is detected (-32.54 dBm), agent logs private note and transfers case with mandatory audit reason
cross_role_interaction_lifecycle.system_audit: Recorded in central audit trail with timestamp and reason

cross_role_interaction_lifecycle.action: NOC Lead inspects PON-4 joint box and generates Field Dispatch Ticket
Field Splicer arrives on-site, executes OTDR repair, and verifies signal recovery to -19.24 dBm
Chat is closed with recorded outcome: 'ISSUE RESOLVED' and customer submits 5-star CSAT rating
